hero.tagline: Turning Raw Data into Strategic Decisions

dynamicTexts: Leading teams of 34 to deliver results

summary.text: I automate what others do manually - saving 12+ hours weekly. I've led 34-member councils, coordinated events for 500+, and now I'm earning my B.Sc. in Data Science to formalize my passion: transforming raw data into strategic decisions.

details: Supported the team by automating manual reporting tasks using Excel macros, helping to save approximately 12 hours of weekly effort.
Collaborated with Finance, Sales, and Ops to help standardize SOPs, contributing to smoother process delivery.
Assisted in analyzing employee feedback to identify opportunities for improving the workplace experience.

exp.company: Student Council - Saint Mary 2 High School, Bandung
details: Developed and implemented talent-development programs reaching all grades as measured by participation rates, by coordinating 10 council divisions and executing class-level activities during pandemic constraints.
Preserved institutional continuity as measured by complete archival handover, by collecting and organizing prior council proposals and 2018 accountability reports for incoming leadership.
Delivered leadership training to 5 junior high schools as measured by event attendance and feedback, by planning curriculum and coordinating trainers.

exp.company: Student Council - Saint Mary 2 High School, Bandung
details: Launched a targeted long-term student quality improvement program as measured by program adoption across homerooms, by defining KPIs, timelines, and execution plans.
Achieved broad outreach to feeder schools as measured by successful promotions to 12 Catholic junior high schools, by leading promotional campaigns and events.
Managed 34 student council members across 10 divisions as measured by maintained operational roster, by delegating responsibilities and instituting weekly coordination cadences.
Created a viral school-promotion social media piece (TikTok) as measured by FYP traction, by producing and overseeing creative content execution.
Built a historical partnership database as measured by compiled brand records, by collecting collaboration data from previous cohorts to inform future outreach.

Ensured seamless execution for events with 1,000+ attendees as measured by adherence to run-sheets, by coordinating backstage logistics and technical transitions with lighting, sound and security teams.
Reduced technical downtime during transitions as measured by average transition time, by standardizing stage procedures and directing the technical crew.
Planned annual program calendar as measured by event completion rate, by coordinating cross-team deliverables and volunteer schedules.
Organized large-scale events as measured by attendance: night gathering (100 participants) and youth worship (400 participants), by managing logistics and volunteer teams.
Maintained monthly acolyte schedules across parish as measured by on-time rosters, by coordinating volunteers and organizing parish-wide ceremonies.
Supported rescue training operations as measured by equipment readiness reports, by performing maintenance and safety inspections on climbing equipment.
